resource_scope.failure: Use only the record-bound teardown command once; do not retry.

cost.local_docker_cost: Local CPU, disk, Docker image/build cache and isolated containers; no dollar estimate.

stop_rules: Before launch, stop if the candidate, launcher hash, remote refs, PR identity, exact-SHA required checks, release ledger, cost disposition, or prior-cycle record differs from this checkpoint.
If the one preview attempt fails or any required route/marker/CSS/CI check is missing or fails, record the stop and do not retry or relaunch.
Do not push, edit the PR, dispatch CI, merge, release, publish, deploy, prune global Docker state, or modify the owner demo.
